briefTitle: A Study of Amivantamab in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors Including Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR)-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant must have histologically or cytologically confirmed, locally advanced or metastatic, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) that is not amenable to curative therapy including surgical resection or chemoradiation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is described without specific numbered stage categories.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Additional Cohort specific disease requirements include: Cohorts 1, 3, 3b, 5, 6 and 7: epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 19 deletion (Exon19del) or Exon 21 L858R mutation; Cohort 2: EGFR Exon 20ins mutation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific variant requirements vary across multiple study arms and cannot be expressed as a single uniform variant check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohorts 1,5,and6: Participant should not have received any prior systemic therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC. Cohort 2: Participant should not have received any prior systemic therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC. Cohorts 3and3b: Participant must have progressed on or after osimertinib monotherapy as the most recent line of treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy rules differ substantially depending on the specific study cohort.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: All cohorts except Cohort 4: Participants must have at least 1 measurable lesion, according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant must be 18 years of age or older
